current_tools_or_products.notes: Current product, tool, or version questions benefit from higher freshness sensitivity and authoritative sources.

stable_architecture_or_design.preferred_research_shape: targeted authoritative sources with restrained browsing
stable_architecture_or_design.notes: Stable architectural reasoning usually benefits from focused sources rather than broad freshness-heavy research.

implementation_with_unknown_api.notes: Unknown API work benefits from official docs first and a clean handoff into implementation.

broad_comparison_request.notes: Broad comparisons benefit from bounded source sets and explicit decision framing.
